title: Fairness in AI-Driven Recruitment: Challenges, Metrics, Methods, and Future Directions
measurement_description: The paper reviews and reports on previous studies that measured bias against religious groups in large language models, particularly in contexts relevant to AI-driven recruitment such as resume screening.
findings: The paper reports, based on cited research, that language models like GPT-3 have demonstrated persistent anti-Muslim bias, which could lead to unfairness in recruitment processes.
